subject: Culture
title: Personal Space Rules
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Personal Space Rules.

hook.text: Stand close to a Finn and they step back. Stand far from a Brazilian and they step closer.

buildup.text: Anthropologist Edward Hall named four distance zones: intimate, personal, social, and public.

discovery.text: Each culture draws those lines differently. Arabs prefer closeness. Scandinavians want arm's length.

twist.text: Violating space triggers the same brain alarm as a physical threat. It's not about manners—it's survival.

climax.text: Diplomats learn space rules before language. Wrong distance can derail a negotiation.

punchline.text: Comfort has a different radius in every country.

quiz.question: Who coined the term 'proxemics' for the study of personal space?
